item.title: Aves
item.description: The series of paintings entitled “Aves” (eng. Birds) was commissioned by the art and culture association CIRCULODEMAJALIS as an illustration of birds from the Montijo region in Portugal. It is part of a traveling exhibition that began at the CIRCULODEMAJALIS headquarters in Canha and is being shown in various cities.

item.title: Igrejas
item.description: Collection of churches ("Igrejas") from the region of Canha and surrounding areas - commissioned and acquired by the parish council (Junta de Freguesia) of Canha, Portugal.

item.title: Insetos
item.description:
The “Insects” series began with an initiative by the association Kehrig Summt to raise awareness of the importance of bees. Since then, it has evolved into a collection of all the insects I find in my garden.

These works are available in the Etsy shop as individual prints and postcard collections.

item.title: Paisagens
item.description:
The places where I sought inspiration…

The works are available as hand-painted originals on canvas and also as postcard prints via Etsy – to give away or keep for yourself.

item.title: Pedras
item.description:
This stone set was originally inspired by the same initiative to raise awareness about bees as the “Insects” series. Since then, I have decided to continue this project with other themes.

These works are available in the Etsy shop as individual prints and postcard collections.
